meta.title: Eight friends, $2,600
meta.prompt: Eight friends are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Each person has a private limit on what they can pay and some things they cannot do, and nobody has said them yet. Can you moderate the discussion, gather everyone's constraints, and reach a plan and a split that all eight members can accept?
meta.context: Eight friends (Hana, Kofi, Lena, Raj, Mei, Sam, Ines, Tom) are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Nobody has said what they can contribute or what they need.

tiers.label: restaurants every meal (gluten-free and vegan menus)

events.text: Hi everyone! Let's get a long weekend started with a draft that stays well under our $2,600 cap and covers the basics we know matter: step-free lodging and vegan-friendly food options. Draft plan: - Lodging B: 4 hotel rooms, step-free – $800 - Transport C: one 12-seat van, 4-hour drive – $300 - Food B: cook + 2 dinners out with vegan options – $480 - Activities B: boat tour only – $280 Total = $1,860 → about $233 per person if split equally. Does this work for you? Please flag any accessibility needs, dietary restrictions beyond vegan/gluten-free, transport preferences, or if your contribution range is different. If you're good with this draft we can lock it in, otherwise tell me what you'd like to change and I'll update.
I'd love it if we could upgrade the food plan to include more restaurant meals, it's a big part of the trip for me

Thanks Lena, food is a big part of the trip for a lot of us. What if we upgrade to Food A: restaurants every meal with gluten-free and vegan menus, while keeping the step-free lodging, the 12-seat van, and the boat tour? That would be Lodging B $800 + Transport C $300 + Food A $800 + Activities B $280 = $2,180 total, about $273 per person if split equally. It stays well under the $2,600 cap and keeps step-free + vegan/gluten-free coverage. Please confirm if this works for you, and flag any accessibility needs, dietary restrictions beyond vegan/gluten-free, transport preferences, or if your contribution range is different.
